summary.text: Heidi Campbell is a Democratic state senator from Nashville representing Tennessee Senate District 20 (part of Davidson County), a member of the 112th through 114th General Assemblies. She is a business owner and serves on the Energy, Agriculture, and Natural Resources and Transportation and Safety committees.

paragraphs.text: Campbell holds a B.A. from Sarah Lawrence and an M.B.A. from the Vanderbilt Owen School of Management.
She is married and has two children.

Her page lists past service on the board of the Greater Nashville Regional Council and the Metro Solid Waste Board and former membership in the Tennessee Mayor's Caucus, along with memberships in the League of Women Voters and the National Women's Political Caucus.
In the Senate she also serves on the Fiscal Review Committee.
